summary: The Bureau of Intergovernmental Relations noted that the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services was among the agencies that endorsed the proposal or offered no adverse comments, and attached their letter accordingly.
text:
Letters endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments on the proposal and statement from the following agencies are attached: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services; Board of Trustees of the Internal Improvement Trust Fund; Game and Fresh Water Fish Commission; Department of Natural Resources; Department of State - Division of Archives History, and Records

Mr. Douglas Hofe, Jr. Page 2 August 14, 1972
Management; and Department of Transportation - Division of Transportation Planning and Programming. No response was received from the Central and Southern Florida Flood Control District.
opening_anchor: Letters endorsing the proposal or offering no adverse comments on the proposal and statement from the following agencies are attached: Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services
closing_anchor: Department of Transportation - Division of Transportation Planning and Programming. No response was received from the Central and Southern Florida Flood Control District.
